messages:
sophie_support: :rotating_light: Customer acme-payments reporting 504s from hosted inference endpoint /v1/generate since 11:22 UTC. Large burst of requests, lots of concurrent short requests. Ticket #INC-8421.
sophie_support: Logs show gateway 502/504s and downstream 504s with error 'upstream timed out' and repeated 'pod not ready' in traces.
kevin_sre: I'm seeing scale-up events around the same time but pods staying in Init: model-load for 30-60s, readiness failing initial probes.
maria_eng: Can you paste the scaledobject/HPA config and KEDA settings? suspect cool-downs or polling intervals.
sophie_support: Scaling config attached from customer: scaledobject pollInterval=30s, cooldownPeriod=300s, minReplicaCount=0, maxReplicaCount=20. HPA target CPU 80.  (paste snippet)
kevin_sre: minReplicaCount=0 + long cooldown + burst means the system tries to cold start -> KEDA triggers but model init + GPU warmup > poll interval -> KEDA thinks scaled pods failed, stalls another scale. Heartbeat mismatch maybe.
sophie_support: Customer says model init time can be 45-70s when cache cold (large model, embeddings). Their request pattern is lots of short requests, not long tail.
tim_oncall: We've got repeated readiness probe failures: `readiness probe failed: kv-cache-unavailable` in pod logs. Also kubelet logs show termination + restart loops for some pods.
kevin_sre: Hypothesis: readiness probe fires before model fully warms; k8s kills pod, prevents it reaching steady state. KEDA/HPA interplay: KEDA triggers, HPA tries to scale but pod count oscillates.
maria_eng: Repro steps I'd try: 1) simulate burst with wrk or simple script; 2) set minReplicaCount=2 and cooldownPeriod=60s to avoid zero baseline; 3) adjust readiness probe to longer initialDelaySeconds and use a probe endpoint that tests KV cache ready.
sophie_support: Customer asked for a quick mitigation now. Any safe temporary change?
kevin_sre: Increase minReplicaCount to 2 for tenant, increase readiness initialDelay to 90s, and set KEDA cooldown to 90s. Also enable graceful prewarm: set env PREWARM=true for the pods so model init runs earlier.
tim_oncall: I'll apply a quick patch to staging config and run synthetic burst. If it looks good, roll to prod for that tenant.
deploy-bot: deploy started by tim_oncall at 11:50 UTC: rollout/tenant-acme-prewarm config -> replicas=2
deploy-bot: rollout complete at 11:54 UTC, new pods in Running state.
kevin_sre: After patch, error rate dropped from 12% to 0.7% in 10m window; latency median back to normal. Logging shows successful KV cache warmup before readiness. :thumbsup:
maria_eng: We'll schedule a follow-up to make readiness probe dependent on KV cache state and add autoscaler guardrails: minReplicaPolicy per tenant and a 'prewarm' feature flag. Also add a metric-based KEDA scaler for queue depth rather than raw RPS for short bursts.
sophie_support: Noted, will tell customer temporary changes applied. They want root cause RCA and permanent fix ETA.
kevin_sre: RCA draft: combination of minReplicaCount=0, long model init/warmup time, and readiness probe mis-timing caused a heartbeat/scale race between KEDA and the kube control loop, resulting in pods never reaching ready and causing gateway timeouts during bursts.
tim_oncall: Follow-ups: (1) Implement probe change and prewarm flag (2) Add tenant-level default minReplica 1 (3) Add eval for cold-init durations per model and warn users in console. Assigning to eng-runtime and product.
sophie_support: I'll respond to customer with mitigations and timeline. Closing incident chat after RCA doc posted. :white_check_mark:
